name: Ice palace
desc: a hall built from frozen water, beautiful and uninhabitable, for cold courts and ordeals
tags: palace of clear ice, translucent ice columns, icicle fringed arches, frost furred surfaces, polished ice floor, snow drifted through the doorway, chandelier of icicles, breath fog in the air
prose: a palace carved from clear ice, translucent columns and icicle-fringed arches, every surface furred with frost, a polished ice floor and snow drifted in through the open doorway
note: Comes back as white marble almost every time. Ice needs transparency nouns to hold - translucent columns, icicles, frost fur on the surfaces - or the material reads as stone. Do not spend words on 'cold' or 'freezing'; the cold look does the temperature and breath fog does the rest.
